ops.title: Locate user regular-file prefilter candidate and verification gates
ops.body: Candidate PR99 at431df65 applies only user-authority proved regular nonmatch after lstat, reusing requested_location. Restricted, directories, all symlinks, special, failed precheck, roots keep old pipeline. Root accepts classification at first metadata observation in non-atomic walk; deterministic mutation fixtures cover replacement after that point. Baseline PR98 f374f9c must show real per-entry canonicalization count20 versus expected0; run41006259637 pending. Candidate full CI41006283981 and independent source/security review pending.
